newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-YELLOW CARDS AND SUSPENSIONS IN EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YELLOW CARDS AND SUSPENSIONS IN EUROPEAN COMPETITIONS.

text.p: The following list shows players with yellow cards going into this week's European Cup Champions' League matches and those suspended from playing in this week's UEFA Cup and Champions' League competitions:
AUXERRE - Suspended: Taribo West. Yellow cards: Sabri Lamouchi, Lilian Laslandes, Bernard Diomede, Philippe Violeau, Antoine Sibierski, Frederic Danjou, Lionel Charbonnier.
GRASSHOPPER ZURICH - Suspended: Kubilay Turkyilmaz, Berndt Haas. Yellow cards: Joel Magnin, Antonio Esposito, Harald Gamperle, Boris Smiljanic.
AJAX - Yellow cards: Mario Melchiot, Roderick Turpijn, Menno Willems.
GLASGOW RANGERS - Suspended: Paul Gascoigne. Yellow cards: Stuart McCall, Brian Laudrup, Gordan Petric, Craig Moore, Ally McCoist.
WIDZEW LODZ - Yellow cards: Slawomir Majak, Radoslaw Michalski, Marek Bajor, Pavel Miaszkiewicz, Jacek Dembinksi, Marek Citko, Pawel Wojtala, Miroslaw Szymkowiak.
STEAUA BUCHAREST - Suspended: Daniel Prodan, Marius Lacatus. Yellow cards: Narcis Raducan, Sabin Ilie, Augustin Calin, Roland Nagy, Denis Serban, Dumitru Rosu, Cristian Ciocoiu, Ilie Miu
BORUSSIA DORTMUND - Yellow cards: Michael Zorc, Julio Cesar, Wolfgang Feiersinger, Heiko Herrlich, Andreas Moeller.
ATLETICO MADRID: - Suspended: Roberto Solozabal. Yellow cards: Milinko Pantic, Toni Munoz, Radek Bejbl, Roberto Fresnedoso, Kiko Narvaez, Jose Luis Caminero, Pablo Alfaro.
MANCHESTER UNITED - Yellow cards: Gary Neville, Jordi Cruyff, David Beckham, Eric Cantona.
FENERBAHCE - Yellow cards: Recber Rustu, Uygun Bulent, Senturk Kemalettin, Dogan Mustafa, Ilker Yagcioglu.
JUVENTUS - Yellow cards: Alen Boksic, Didier Deschamps, Angelo Peruzzi, Sergio Porrini, Ciro Ferrara, Moreno Torricelli, Vladimir Jugovic.
RAPID VIENNA - Suspended: Andrzej Lesiak. Yellow cards: Peter Guggi, Trifon Ivanov, Peter Schoettel, Dietmar Kuhbauer, Peter Stoeger, Sergei Mandreko, Marek Penska, Andreas Heraf
PORTO - Yellow cards: Artur Oliveira, Fernando Memdes, Jorge Costa, Luiz Marco, Ljubinko Drulovic, Aloisio Alves, Edmilson, Rui Barros, Sergio Conceicao, Zlatko Zahovic.
ROSENBORG - Suspended: Jahn Ivar Jakobsen. Yellow cards: Jon Olav Hjelde, Roar Strand, Tom Staurvik, Bent Skammelsrud, Harald Brattbakk, Bjorn Kvarme, Bjorn Bragstad.
AC MILAN - Suspended: George Weah, Marcel Desailly, Stefano Eranio. Yellow cards: Marco Simone, Alessandro Costacurta, Edgar Davids.
IFK GOTHENBURG - Suspended: Niclas Alexandersson. Yellow cards: Magnus Erlingmark, Jesper Blomqvist, Stefan Lindqvist, Mikael Martinsson
